description.en-US: The stable integration identifier an external module names this channel by, so nothing outside Sales has to know a database id (CR 7.1, 42). Lowercase alphanumeric only, and immutable: 'vdmc' is a published contract, so renaming it or changing its case breaks every kiosk already configured against it. Required and unique across the table (DEC-001) — the earlier nullable form could not be expressed as a constraint, and a channel without a code could never gain one because this field cannot be updated.
The display name shown to a human. Free to change; the code is what integration depends on.

The module that registered this channel, for example 'vending_machine_new'. Plain metadata with no foreign key into any module registry (CR 8): it exists so that one module cannot take over another module's channel, and so the UI can warn that a channel's real lifecycle is owned elsewhere. NULL for a channel a human created.

The business lifecycle. Suspended stops new sales points and new orders while leaving history, returns, refunds and fiscal adjustments working (CR 9). Distinct from is_archived, which is the system lifecycle: the two must not substitute for each other. Written only by the suspend and activate actions, never by a plain update, so no transition escapes its audit event.

Whether this channel is seeded and owned by the system rather than by a user. A system channel may be suspended and have its payment methods configured, but may not be archived, deleted or renamed through the API (D-23): archiving 'vdmc' would silently stop every kiosk selling. Set by seed migrations alone.
